tracks.name: Meta-World v2原表 · MT50 · 状态型多任务RL
tracks.version: arXiv v2 2021 benchmark report; no asserted modern package version
tracks.split: training skills only; 2500 sampled task configurations; task ID/goal available
tracks.protocol: Table 1最大成功率跨任务与10种子汇总；39维状态和任务编码，4维末端/夹爪动作，非像素VLA。每种环境50个预采样配置；MT评测已见技能，不是5类新技能泛化；不同算法预算按原附录保留，paper-table不排名。
tracks.trainingRegime: Online state-based RL, no demonstration budget; Appendix D separate per-method budgets: PPO/TRPO epochs10000, SAC epochs500, TE epochs2000; rollout horizon500. These are algorithm-defined epochs, not equal interaction budgets.
